newsitem.title: KENYA: Nairobi bourse index eases in sellers market.
newsitem.headline: Nairobi bourse index eases in sellers market.

text.p: The Nairobi Stock Exchange (NSE) 20-share index eased marginally on Tuesday reflecting an underlying sellers' tone in the market, brokers said.

The index lost 13.44 points to close at 3433.86. Turnover dropped to 18.234 million shillings on 367,177 shares compared to 66.927 million shillings_VWKM are still trading cautiously, sitting on the sidelines," a bourse official said.
Brokers added that where index-linked shares especially in the financials were stable, they were outdone by falling prices in other counters.
Barclays Bank was unchanged at 111 while Total Kenya shed 1.50 to close at 69. Kenya Comercial Bank was steady at 97 while Uchumi Supermarket eased to 40.25 from 42.
Last week, the Nairobi bourse index took a downward turn dragged by disappointed investors who speculated over year-end financial-based results anticipating bonus issues.

Trading on the bourse's special boards -- the three-day offer board and the one-hour hold board -- was the latest feature in the market and would remain, for as long as there was demand from foreign institutional investors, brokers said.
"With all this big lots being traded on the special boards, the market has become a wholesaler's market," one broker said.
Sasini Tea & Coffee was unchanged at 75 while Rea Vipingo Plantations eased to 74 from 75.
Kenya Airways closed at 8.55 from 8.60 while Kenya Power & Lighting was unchanged at 118.
